summary: extractConcepts is a Phase-1 LIKE match on concept labels; abstract queries with no lexical overlap extract 0 concepts and the graph leg goes fully dark. Measured: 'non-dual awareness' and 'ego death' returned 0 concepts / 0 graph candidates (2/12 canonical queries) despite the corpus having 11k EXPRESSES edges. Consider matching against concept definitions/synonyms or embedding-based concept selection.

analysis.author: Backend Engineer
analysis.content: v3 benchmark on local corpus (3089 chunks, 25820 EXPRESSES, corpus_version 27): three-namespace extractConcepts fixed the lexical-overlap cases — cosmology now extracts 27 concepts (domain 'Cosmology'→27 + family 'Soul Cosmology'→3), the One 16, divine names 25, the cosmos 17, cosmic agents 13, ego death 2 (was dark). Graph leg fires 14/16, avg 6.06 traditions in top-K, 0/16 below coverage target, latency ~75ms avg. STILL DARK: 'non-dual awareness' and 'salvation' (0 concepts) — no concept/family/domain label lexically contains them (the domain is 'Soteriology', not 'Salvation'); these need the alias tables, which ship empty. So the debt is substantially reduced but its tail (pure-synonym queries) remains until concept_aliases/family_aliases are populated.
